description: Defines the Response class in the OrangeHRM API v2, providing methods to format response data, meta information, and errors as JSON strings.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class for generating JSON formatted responses including data, metadata, and relations, used in the OrangeHRM API v2.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Response object with data, meta information, and relations.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the data payload as a JSON-encoded string.

methods.name: formatData
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded string containing data, meta, and relations.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Static method that returns a JSON-encoded string of the provided error details.
